entities.name: Extended EPS QoS
entities.description: Information element used to transmit maximum and guaranteed bit rate values from UE to network when values exceed EPS QoS IE limits.

entities.name: EPS QoS
entities.description: EPS quality of service information element defined in clause 9.9.4.3 with maximum value limits for bit rates.

entities.name: Bit rate exceeds EPS QoS limit
entities.description: Condition where at least one maximum or guaranteed bit rate value exceeds the maximum value specified in the EPS QoS IE.

entities.name: UE wishes to transmit bit rates
entities.description: Condition where the UE wishes to transmit maximum and guaranteed bit rate values to the network.

relations.description: Extended EPS QoS IE inclusion is guarded by UE's wish to transmit bit rate values.
Extended EPS QoS IE inclusion is guarded by bit rate values exceeding EPS QoS IE limits.
Extended EPS QoS IE establishes extended capability beyond standard EPS QoS IE limits.
